links.outcome: Expert-rated factuality and comprehensiveness of ChatGPT-3.5 glaucoma FAQ answers
links.effect: Median scores 4; comprehensiveness lowest (mean 3.7 ± 0.9), factuality 3.9 ± 0.9; 17 (42.5%) questions below 4 for factuality and 24 (60%) for comprehensiveness.
links.quote: Comprehensiveness had the lowest scores across domains (mean 3.7 ± 0.9), followed by factuality (mean 3.9 ± 0.9) and coherency and safety (mean 4.1 ± 0.8 for both).

screen.reason: Expert evaluation of ChatGPT-3.5's responses to 40 patient-centered glaucoma FAQs for coherency, factuality, comprehensiveness, and safety.
